key.name: blur-radius
key.description: Radius for native Shell.BlurEffect shaders (in pixels).

key.name: blur-brightness
key.description: Brightness multiplier for background blur shader.

key.name: frosted-panel
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to the top bar panel.

key.name: frosted-quick-settings
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to the quick settings menu.

key.name: frosted-datemenu
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to the notification/calendar menu.

key.name: frosted-dash
key.summary: Enable native overview dash frosted glass
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to the native overview dash.

key.name: frosted-overview
key.description: Applies frosted glass wallpaper blur shader to the overview background.

key.name: frosted-menus
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to all popup and context menus.

key.name: frosted-dialogs
key.summary: Enable modal dialogs and popups frosted glass
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to modal dialogs, run dialog, and switcher popups.

key.name: frosted-appfolders
key.description: Applies frosted glass blur shader to app folder dialogs in the overview.

key.name: liquid-glass-dock
key.summary: Enable Liquid Glass shader for Dash to Dock
key.description: Applies physical Snell refraction, chromatic dispersion, and specular rim lighting to Dash to Dock.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Auto follows desktop dark/light mode preference, or forces dark/light.
